title: Tower Records Japan data breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Tower Records Japan, Nikkei, Investing.com, NHK, Asahi Shimbun, Sankei Shimbun, Yomiuri Shimbun, Bloomberg, The Japan Times, Fuji TV (FNN) or any other company, news outlet, government agency, or anyone else named.
size_basis: About 11 million records of customer data, from a retailer's online shop, per the company. Counts overlap and the number of distinct people is not published.
who_is_affected: Tower Records members, including some who left within three years. Leaked: email, member ID, password hash, and for some, name, birth date, address or phone. Card data was not, per the company.

known.text: An outside party got into Tower Records Online without authorisation on Nov 19.
The company stopped the shop at about 5:10 PM JST and it is still offline for checks.
About 11 million records leaked, including people who left within three years.
10,214,652 login records: email, member ID and password hash.
No credit card information was included, per the company.

not_known.text: Whether the data has been used against customers.

figures.label: Records leaked
figures.detail: About, per the company; counts overlap
